env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOAMD64=v1
env GOARM64=v8.0

# Explicit O3 reaches Go packages and their dependencies. Lower tiers keep
# the previous compiler behavior; the command's action ID contains the flag.
go build -O=3 -x -o opt.exe .
stderr 'logosopt=1'
exec ./opt.exe
stdout '^scalar parity: ok$'
go build -O=2 -x -o opt.exe .
! stderr 'logosopt=1'
exec ./opt.exe
stdout '^scalar parity: ok$'

# The same source must work through loGo/s lowering, configuration selection,
# an explicit lower-tier override, and upstream compilation after eject.
mv main.go main.lgo
logos build -O=3 -x -o opt.exe .
stderr 'logosopt=1'
exec ./opt.exe
stdout '^scalar parity: ok$'
cp o3.toml logos.toml
logos build -a -x -o opt.exe .
stderr 'logosopt=1'
exec ./opt.exe
stdout '^scalar parity: ok$'
logos build -O=1 -x -o opt.exe .
! stderr 'logosopt=1'
exec ./opt.exe
stdout '^scalar parity: ok$'
logos eject -o out
cd out
exists $UPROOT1274/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1274/bin/go run .
stdout '^scalar parity: ok$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/scalaropt

go 1.27
-- o3.toml --
[build]
opt_level = "O3"
target_cpu = "baseline"
arena = false
-- main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

var calls int

//go:noinline
func effect(x uint64) uint64 {
	calls++
	return x
}

//go:noinline
func masked(x, y uint64) uint64 {
	return ((effect(x) &^ 255) + (y &^ 255) + 37) & 255
}

//go:noinline
func rotate(x uint64) uint64 {
	x &= 255
	return (x<<8 | x>>56) & 255
}

//go:noinline
func correlated(flag bool) uint64 {
	var x, y uint64
	if flag {
		effect(1)
		x, y = 1, 3
	} else {
		effect(2)
		x, y = 2, 2
	}
	return x + y
}

func main() {
	for i := uint64(0); i < 1024; i++ {
		x := i * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15
		if masked(x, ^x) != 37 || rotate(x) != 0 || correlated(i&1 != 0) != 4 {
			panic("incorrect scalar optimization")
		}
	}
	if calls != 2048 {
		panic("scalar optimization removed an effect")
	}
	fmt.Println("scalar parity: ok")
}
